data.one_liner: Converts logical RTL strings to their visual representation using the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm.
data.what_it_does: The package implements the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm to transform logical order text (e.g., Persian, Arabic, Hebrew) into the visual order required for display. It works entirely in Dart and supports null‑safety.
use_when: You need to display RTL text correctly in a Flutter or Dart app without native dependencies
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution for logical‑to‑visual conversion
avoid_when: You need full layout handling or complex script shaping
Performance is critical for very large texts
You require a native Rust implementation for maximum speed
strengths: Supports major RTL languages out of the box
weaknesses: Only handles string conversion, not full rendering
May be slower than the Rust counterpart for large workloads
